in_hebrew.name: עובדיאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עובדיאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'עובד אל' או 'עבד האל'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'עובד' שפירושו 'עובד' או 'משרת', ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוקים' או 'האל'. השם עובדיאל מופיע בתנ"ך כבן של רוים וגד, ויש לו חשיבות רבה במסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד. השם עובדיאל מסמל את המסירות וההכנעה לאלוקים, והוא נחשב לשם בעל משמעות רוחנית עמוקה.

in_greek.name: Ουβδιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ουβδιήλ είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'υπηρέτης του Θεού' ή 'δουλος του Θεού'. Το όνομα Ουβδιήλ αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'ουβδ' που σημαίνει 'υπηρέτης' ή 'δουλος', και 'ηλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ουβδιήλ δεν αναφέρεται ρητά, αλλά η έννοια του ονόματος έχει μεγάλη σημασία στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας. Το όνομα Ουβδιήλ συμβολίζει την αφοσίωση και την υποταγή στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Obediel
in_latin.long_meaning: Obediel est nomen latinum quod significat 'servus Dei' vel 'minister Dei'. Nomen Obediel derivatur ex hebraeo et componitur ex duobus verbis: 'obed' quod significat 'servus' vel 'minister', et 'El' quod significat 'Deus'. In ecclesia primitiva, nomen Obediel habet magnam significationem spiritualem et symbolicam. Obediel significat devotionem et subiectionem Deo.

in_english.name: Obediel
in_english.meaning: Servant of God or Worshipper of God
in_english.long_meaning: Obediel is a Christian name derived from Hebrew roots, meaning 'servant of God' or 'worshipper of God'. It is composed of two words: 'obed' meaning 'servant' or 'worshipper', and 'El' meaning 'God'. The name Obediel appears in the Bible as the son of Rueben and Gad, and holds significant importance in both Jewish and Christian traditions. Obediel symbolizes devotion, surrender, and spiritual dedication to God. The name is associated with positive personality traits such as humility, loyalty, and faithfulness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Obediel may have cultural significance as a reminder of the importance of obedience and service in religious communities. It is a distinctive Christian name rooted in biblical history, inspired by a servant of God who demonstrated faithfulness and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: On a more spiritual level, the name Obediel holds great significance for those who desire to honor God in their daily lives. It represents a commitment to put God's will above one's own and to strive for a close, obedient relationship with Him. In Christian traditions, the name may be seen as a reminder to live a life dedicated to serving God and following His teachings.

historical_references.reference: Obediel, a name mentioned in the Old Testament Book of Ezra (3:2), is believed to be a descendant of Shealtiel, the high priest, and part of the group of exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon under the leadership of Zerubbabel and Jeshua in 538 BC to rebuild the Second Temple.
historical_references.context: Return of the exiles from Babylon

historical_references.reference: Obediel the Levite is mentioned in 1 Chronicles 6:31 as a son of Shemaiah, a descendant of Levi, who was the third son of Jacob. This Obediel is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles 15:12 and 15:15 as a gatekeeper at the house of God during the time of King David in the late 10th or early 9th century BC.
historical_references.context: Service at the temple during the reign of King David
